name: Futtsu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Futtsu city emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised letter V, with two curved strokes above.
history: Municipal flag of Futtsu, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 1971.

features.role: Futtsu city emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised letter V, with two curved strokes above
